ننتهج (form VII)
# نَنْتَهِجُ (nantahiju) /nan.ta.hi.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
# نُنْتَهَجُ (nuntahaju) /nun.ta.ha.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
# نَنْتَهِجَ (nantahija) /nan.ta.hi.d͡ʒa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
# نُنْتَهَجَ (nuntahaja) /nun.ta.ha.
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
